education_period_is_dated.name: education_period_is_dated
education_period_is_dated.value: "profile"."education"."started_on" IS NOT NULL OR "profile"."education"."ended_on" IS NOT NULL

education_period_is_ordered.name: education_period_is_ordered
education_period_is_ordered.value: "profile"."education"."started_on" IS NULL OR "profile"."education"."ended_on" IS NULL OR "profile"."education"."ended_on" >= "profile"."education"."started_on"

media_dimensions_match_type.name: media_dimensions_match_type
media_dimensions_match_type.value: ("profile"."media"."media_type" = 'application/pdf' AND "profile"."media"."width" IS NULL AND "profile"."media"."height" IS NULL) OR ("profile"."media"."media_type" <> 'application/pdf' AND "profile"."media"."width" IS NOT NULL AND "profile"."media"."height" IS NOT NULL AND "profile"."media"."width" > 0 AND "profile"."media"."height" > 0)

service_evidence_matches_kind.name: service_evidence_matches_kind
service_evidence_matches_kind.value:
CASE "profile"."service_evidence"."kind"
        WHEN 'project' THEN "profile"."service_evidence"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "profile"."service_evidence"."exploration_id" IS NULL
          AND "profile"."service_evidence"."link_label" IS NULL AND "profile"."service_evidence"."link_path" IS NULL
        WHEN 'exploration' THEN "profile"."service_evidence"."exploration_id" IS NOT NULL AND "profile"."service_evidence"."project_id" IS NULL
          AND "profile"."service_evidence"."link_label" IS NULL AND "profile"."service_evidence"."link_path" IS NULL
        ELSE "profile"."service_evidence"."link_label" IS NOT NULL AND "profile"."service_evidence"."link_path" IS NOT NULL
          AND "profile"."service_evidence"."project_id" IS NULL AND "profile"."service_evidence"."exploration_id" IS NULL
      END

books_period_is_ordered.name: books_period_is_ordered
books_period_is_ordered.value: "ai_roadmap"."books"."started_on" IS NULL OR "ai_roadmap"."books"."ended_on" IS NULL OR "ai_roadmap"."books"."ended_on" >= "ai_roadmap"."books"."started_on"

resources_period_is_ordered.name: resources_period_is_ordered
resources_period_is_ordered.value: "ai_roadmap"."resources"."started_at" IS NULL OR "ai_roadmap"."resources"."finished_at" IS NULL OR "ai_roadmap"."resources"."finished_at" >= "ai_roadmap"."resources"."started_at"

time_entries_within_diary_day.name: time_entries_within_diary_day
time_entries_within_diary_day.value: "ai_roadmap"."time_entries"."diary_date" = ("ai_roadmap"."time_entries"."started_at" AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Prague')::date AND "ai_roadmap"."time_entries"."ended_at" <= (("ai_roadmap"."time_entries"."diary_date" + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Prague')
